name: KiWay Harness and Cable Workbench
description: Build multi-board harness maps, drawings, bundles, splices, and BoMs.
description_full: Imports up to 50 board pin CSV documents, maps arbitrary connector pins, bundles, splices, gauges, and loads, and joins safeguarded Pin Extractor controller maps into complete IC-to-IC or IC-to-peripheral routes through series components. Exports sortable tables, CSV, SVG, an offline pan/zoom/draggable interactive system harness, findings, and a procurement BoM.
